description: Create an RLS regression test harness that validates the policies are correctly enforced for each role. Save test file to repository and run validation queries against live Supabase.
steps: Create tests/regression_rls.sql following the same pattern as tests/regression_v1.1.5.sql (DO $$ blocks with RAISE NOTICE for PASS, RAISE EXCEPTION for FAIL)
Test T-RLS-01: Verify all 34 tables have RLS enabled
Test T-RLS-02: Verify authenticated role has USAGE on perfecity schema
Test T-RLS-03: Verify policies exist for all 34 tables (check pg_policies)
Test T-RLS-04: Verify the perfecity.current_user_role() helper function exists and returns expected claims from JWT
Test T-RLS-05: Count total policies and verify minimum expected count (at least 1 SELECT + appropriate write policies per table category)
Run the test harness via execute_sql on Supabase to confirm all checks pass
Update docs/deployment_runbook.md Post-Deployment Security section to reference the new migration and test file
acceptance_criteria: tests/regression_rls.sql exists and follows project test patterns
All T-RLS tests pass when run against live Supabase
docs/deployment_runbook.md updated to reference RLS migration
verification: Run tests/regression_rls.sql via execute_sql on Supabase - all tests must pass
Verify file exists at tests/regression_rls.sql in the repository
